adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` to call `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` instead of creating a post with `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])`. In `TopicEmbed.import_remote` it `open(url).read`s (live HTTP fetch) and then calls `TopicEmbed.import`, which hard-returns `nil` unless `url` matches `^https?://` and creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` (so cooked == raw). There is no passing of the original Disqus `created_at` into `PostCreator`, so imported topics/posts will get import-time timestamps. One detail in the finding is off: a fetch failure via `open(url)` would raise (not “silently skip”), but the timestamp-loss / behavior change is clearly introduced by this diff.
